summary: In community.vmware, vmware_dvswitch_pvlans now treats the VLAN ID as an integer.
questions: What type should private VLAN IDs be in vmware_dvswitch_pvlans?

answer_card.title: vmware_dvswitch_pvlans VLAN ID type
answer_card.answer_md: `vmware_dvswitch_pvlans` now handles VLAN IDs as integers. Pass numbers, not strings.
